title: Calibration Check-Ins: "No useable driver found"
body: The Calibration Check-Ins are not working. When I click on the button, it says that the calibrations are checked-in but in the log there is appearing the message "No useable driver found".

comments.body:
This should be resolved in the March 27th nightly by commit https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/e0703334b06dd33248e70de1c471f82ea5147525

Thanks for reporting the issue. Please let me know if it works.
